title: release-cutover-checklist-daily-scratchpad-2026-03-22
content:
Sprint cutover day scratchpad - quick notes and TODOs
Owner: Emma Chen (release engineering)
Date: 2026-03-22

Context:
- Rolling release for runtime v2.9.1 + quantization patch. Canary started 03:00 PDT, target full rollout 09:00 PDT.
- Coordinating with infra (Aisha), SRE (Jordan), and applied-ml (Samira).

Pre-cutover (confirm before start)
- [ ] All release PRs merged to release branch (GH PR #1293, #1296) -> verify CI green
- [x] Backports created for critical fixes -> PRs: #1293 (runtime crash fix), #1301 (kv-cache edge), #1304 (quant param)
- [x] DB migrations reviewed and in the migration plan (no downtime flags)
- [x] Canary infra healthy (canary cluster: canary-rw-3)
- [x] Monitoring dashboards shared with SRE and PM (links in linked_artifacts)
- [ ] Update status page template (ask comms for blerb)

Pre-cutover quick checks (commands)
- Check canary logs: kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime-canary --tail 200
- Verify loadtest baseline: ./scripts/query-loadtest --env=canary --runs=5
- Confirm KMS keys accessible: aws kms list-keys --region us-west-2

Cutover timeline (rough)
- 08:30 PDT: Final sync call (15m) - all leads
- 09:00 PDT: Start progressive rollout phase 1 -> 10% traffic, wait 10m
- 09:20 PDT: Validate metrics (latency p95, error rate, token cost)
- 09:40 PDT: If stable, increase to 30% -> wait 15m
- 10:10 PDT: If stable, increase to 60% -> wait 20m
- 10:40 PDT: Full rollout to 100% (target by 11:00 PDT)

During cutover (monitoring checklist)
- [ ] Metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, token throughput, cpu/gpu util, queue length
- [ ] Alerts: any >= 2x increase in p95 or >= 0.5% increase in 5xx -> pause rollout
- [ ] SRE on-call (Jordan) watching infra alerts in Slack #sre-alerts
- [ ] PM/Eng leads in #release-ops channel for rapid decisioning
- [ ] Snapshot canary logs at each step and upload to GH issue

Validation tests (post-step smoke)
- Run smoke: ./ci/smoke-tests.sh --env=staging-canary (expect pass)
- Quick functional checks: chat generation, streaming, embeddings sample (use small prompt set)
- Run perf spot checks: sample 100 requests and record avg tokens/sec

Rollback plan (if threshold exceeded)
- Thresholds: p95 latency > baseline * 2 OR 5xx rate > 0.5%
- Immediate action: pause rollout and rollback to previous release tag v2.9.0
- Commands: kubectl rollout undo deploy/runtime --to-revision=<prev> -n inference
- Notify: post update in #release-ops and ping SRE and PM, open incident (JIRA-INC-XXXX)
- Postmortem owner: assign to the engineer who merged offending PR (TBD)

Post-cutover tasks
- [ ] Confirm canary metrics stable for 60m after 100%
- [ ] Close rollout ticket and tag release notes (release-notes/2026-03)
- [ ] Trigger post-release evaluation job (quality/regression tests)
- [ ] Update internal docs with any rollout anomalies

Backports and open items
- Backport list (must watch):
  - #1293 runtime crash fix (merged to release branch)
  - #1301 kv-cache edge (needs QA) -> Jordan to verify in canary
  - #1304 quant param default change (approved)
- Unresolved: which models need new quant profile? (Samira to confirm list)
- Note: still have one flaky test in embeddings CI (flaky-emb-12) - not blocking but track post-release

Communications
- Status page: templated message (TBD) -> short outage? No. Post: "Routine rollout of runtime v2.9.1 starting 09:00 PDT. No expected downtime. We'll monitor and update."
- Slack: #release-ops (primary), #sre-alerts (monitoring), DM main leads for decision points
- Customer notifications: none planned for this minor release (confirm with comms if needed)

Notes to self / TODOs
- 08:15: check with infra that node group autoscaling policy is ready for increased load (Aisha)
- 08:40: paste final checklist into GH release issue and start video call link
- Remember to document any manual steps we do to workaround model quant regressions
- If we see >1% token cost increase after rollout, open tracking ticket for optimizer team

Random scratch thoughts (keep short)
- If rollback happens, consider smaller canary increments next time (5% steps)
- Need a small playbook section for quant profile hotfixes - currently ad-hoc

-- end scratchpad --
